descricao_original: Active fibroblasts are resident cells found in connective tissues. Their nuclei are euchromatic and elongated. This toluidine blue stain of loose connective tissue beneath an epithelium demonstrates the pale-staining collagen fibers and heavily stained elastic fibers. Blood vessels are also visible. 1000x
